info.title: Laravel
info.description: CaseDex API for the web and mobile apps. Every record is identified by its ULID `public_id`. Mobile apps sign in with `POST /mobile/login` and send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; the full guide (errors, onboarding states, push) is docs/mobile-api.md. Generated from the code: run `php artisan scramble:export` after changing routes, requests or resources.
